question: Who among the following received the Padma Bhushan posthumously in 2025 for his contribution to music?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Pankaj Udhas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pankaj Udhas** was a renowned **Indian ghazal singer** who contributed significantly to the revival and popularization of **ghazal music in India**.
 
• He started his career with the release of his first ghazal album in the **1980s** and soon gained immense popularity for his soulful voice and lyrical compositions.
 
• Pankaj Udhas is widely known for his ghazals such as "**Chitthi Aayi Hai**" from the Bollywood movie **Naam** (1986), which became a cultural phenomenon.
 
• He was honored with the **Padma Bhushan posthumously** in **2025** for his exceptional contribution to Indian music and ghazal singing.
 
• The **Padma Bhushan** is India's third-highest civilian award, recognizing distinguished service of a high order in any field, including arts and music.
 
• Pankaj Udhas' contribution to ghazal music has left a lasting legacy, inspiring both contemporary and upcoming artists in the genre.
 
• His work not only brought ghazal music closer to the younger generation but also ensured its presence in mainstream Indian music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sharda Sinha**__

 __
 
• **Sharda Sinha** is a renowned **Indian folk singer** from Bihar, known for her Bhojpuri and Maithili songs.
 
• She received the **Padma Bhushan in 2018** for her contribution to folk music.
 
• Her songs are especially popular during festivals such as **Chhath Puja**.
 
 
 
• **Anant Nag**__
 __
 
• **Anant Nag** is a celebrated **Indian actor**, primarily working in the **Kannada film industry**.
 
• He is known for his versatile roles in films and is one of the most respected figures in South Indian cinema.
 
 
 
• **Lakshminarayana Subramaniam**__
 
 
• **Dr. L. Subramaniam** is a globally acclaimed **violinist** and composer in the field of **Carnatic classical and western fusion music**.
 
• He has performed in numerous prestigious venues and has collaborated with several international musicians.
